TypeTorch Sync: attaches Roblox Studio to `typetorch serve` by itself and keeps it synced, with no Connect button and no reconnecting by hand. It also lets an agent drive Studio (play, stop, Output), pushes code into a running playtest, publishes hot assets from a panel, pairs with a teammate's `typetorch serve --remote` through one link, and has a Claude window that prompts Claude Code on the serve machine (`typetorch serve --claude`).

Docs and source: github.com/typetorch/studio-plugin
